summary: Concentra Group Holdings Parent, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a stock repurchase agreement dated August 21, 2026, to buy 1,000,000 common shares from chairman Robert A. Ortenzio and related entities at $34.65 per share, total $34.65 million, a 1% discount to the August 21 closing price. The Audit and Compliance Committee, comprised solely of independent directors, approved the transaction, which closed August 24, 2026, funded from cash on hand and represents 0.784% of shares outstanding. The purchase was made under the company's previously announced share repurchase program. Watch for potential insider-selling signals or further buyback activity under the program.
